mobile.rescan: Look for changes made by other apps
mobile.rescan-done: The vault is up to date.
mobile.no-git: Git is not available on Android. Sync this folder with a sync app instead.
mobile.no-windows: sk_notes has one window on Android.
mobile.place-app-desc: Private to sk_notes. Needs no permission; removed if you uninstall the app.
mobile.place-device-desc: In your Documents folder: sync apps and file managers can reach it.
mobile.place-other-desc: Choose where to create the vault.
mobile.storage-explain: To use folders outside its own storage, sk_notes needs Android's "access to all files" permission. It is used only for the folders you choose.
mobile.storage-denied: Access to the device storage was not allowed.
mobile.tb.heading: Heading
mobile.skai.intro: SKAI is the AI of Skorpion OS. A phone cannot run it, so sk_notes uses the SKAI of a PC on the same network: a PC with Skorpion OS, or any PC running Ollama with its endpoint open to the network. Away from that network SKAI is offline and everything else keeps working.
mobile.skai.host-desc: IP address or name, for example 192.168.1.20. Port {port} is used unless you add another (192.168.1.20:8080).
mobile.skai.bad-host: This is not a valid address.
mobile.skai.find-desc: Looks on the Wi-Fi network this phone is connected to for PCs that answer as Ollama.
mobile.skai.none-found: No PC answered. Check that the phone is on the same Wi-Fi and that Ollama on the PC accepts connections from the network (see below).
mobile.skai.not-set: No PC set: SKAI is off.
mobile.skai.offline: No answer from {host}. Is the phone on the same network as the PC?
mobile.skai.model-desc: The chat model of the PC that answers.
mobile.skai.help-text: By default Ollama answers only to its own PC. To let the phones of your network use it, make it listen on the network. On Skorpion OS and other Linux systems:
mobile.skai.privacy: The connection is plain HTTP inside your network: what you ask SKAI, and the notes it reads to answer, are sent to that PC and nowhere else. Use it on networks you trust.
mobile.plugins.browse-desc: Search the public directory of community plugins and install them from their GitHub releases.
mobile.plugins.browse-note: The list comes from the public directory of community plugins on GitHub. Plugins are code written by third parties: install only the ones you trust.
mobile.plugins.load-failed: The list could not be downloaded: {error}
mobile.plugins.up-to-date: Every plugin is up to date.
mobile.plugins.restricted-hint: Turn off restricted mode to enable it.
plugins.unclean-question: sk_notes did not finish starting last time, while community plugins were loading. A plugin may have frozen or crashed it. Start without community plugins this time?
plugins.desktop-only: Made for PCs only: it may not work on a phone.
plugins.install-desc: From a folder with manifest.json and main.js, or from the release of a GitHub repository (owner/repository).
settings.about-text: sk_notes is part of Skorpion OS. Everything stays on your device: no account, no telemetry. The only network connections are the ones you ask for: SKAI on a PC of your network, and GitHub when you install a community plugin. Licensed under GPL-3.0. sk_notes is not affiliated with Obsidian or Dynalist Inc.
settings.base-theme-desc: "Follow the system" uses Android's light or dark theme.
settings.zoom-desc: Size of the text of the whole app.
settings.trash-system: Move to the vault's trash (.trash folder)
settings.config-folder-desc: Settings, plugins, themes and snippets of this vault live in its .sk_notes folder. The layout of the phone is kept apart from the one of the PC.
sync.intro: sk_notes has no sync servers. A vault is a normal folder: sync it yourself with a sync app working on that folder.
sync.git-missing: Git is not available on Android. To use Git, sync the vault to a PC and use Git there, or install a Git community plugin.
sync.syncthing-missing: No Syncthing app found. Install one (for example Syncthing-Fork) and share the vault folder with your PC; keep the vault in the device storage so the app can reach it.
sync.syncthing-not-configured: A Syncthing app is installed. Open it and share the vault folder with your PC; sk_notes notices the changes it brings.
skai.offline-panel: SKAI is offline: the PC set in Settings → SKAI does not answer (it must be on the same network). The rest of sk_notes works normally.
skai.error.unreachable: SKAI is offline: the PC set in Settings → SKAI does not answer.
skai.error.no_model: No AI model is installed on the PC. Install one there with SKAI Manager.
skai.error.model_missing: The model chosen in Settings → SKAI is not installed on the PC: {detail}
error.bad-host: This is not a valid address.
error.git-missing: Git is not available on Android.
error.source-inside-vault: The source is inside the vault.
error.output-inside-vault: Choose a folder outside the vault.
mobile.pdf-failed: This PDF could not be shown.
mobile.templates.title: Community templates
mobile.templates.note: Ready-made notes to start from. Tap one to add it to your templates folder.
mobile.themes.title: Community themes
mobile.themes.desc: Browse the public directory of community themes and use one with a tap.
mobile.themes.note: The list comes from the public directory of community themes on GitHub. Tap a theme to download and use it. Themes are made by third parties for another app: some may not fit sk_notes perfectly.
mobile.home.title: Home
mobile.menu.template-needs-note: Open a note first: the template is inserted where the cursor is.
mobile.versions.title: Versions: {name}
mobile.versions.intro: Every version kept of this note, newest first. Tap one to see what it changed, go back to it, or take some of its changes.
mobile.versions.sum-previous: In this version – lines added: {added}, removed: {removed}
mobile.versions.sum-current: From this version to now – lines added: {added}, removed: {removed}
mobile.versions.same-current: This version is the same as the note now.
mobile.versions.go-confirm: The note becomes this version. The note as it is now is kept as a version, so you can come forward again.
mobile.versions.went: The note is now the version of {when}.
mobile.versions.take-intro: The changes this version made. Tick the ones to bring into the note as it is now; the rest of the note stays as it is.
mobile.sync.title: Sync (GitHub, GitLab)
mobile.sync.intro: Keep this vault in a private repository of GitHub, GitLab or your own Git server. sk_notes then sends your changes there and fetches the ones made elsewhere, by itself. On a PC you work on the same notes with Obsidian (and its Git plugin), Foam, Tolaria or Git itself.
mobile.sync.address-desc: The https:// address of the repository.
mobile.sync.secret-github: GitHub does not accept the account password from apps: it wants an access token. Press "Create token", sign in, press "Generate token" at the bottom of the page, copy the token and paste it here.
mobile.sync.secret-gitlab: An access token (press "Create token"), or your GitLab password if the account has no two-step sign-in.
mobile.sync.secret-other: The password or the access token of your account on that server.
mobile.sync.repo-desc: Where the notes are kept. Choose the one your PC already uses, or make a new one.
mobile.sync.repo-type-desc: Type it as name/repository, or paste its address.
mobile.sync.first: Connecting and syncing for the first time…
mobile.sync.linked: Connected. This vault is now synced.
mobile.sync.offline: No connection: sync resumes when it is back.
mobile.sync.linked-intro: This vault is synced with the repository below. Changes are sent a little after you make them, and fetched when the app opens, when you come back to it and at the interval you choose.
mobile.sync.auto-desc: Send and fetch changes without asking.
mobile.sync.every-desc: How often to look for changes made on other devices while the app is open.
mobile.sync.pc-text: Clone the same repository and open its folder with Obsidian (the Git plugin syncs it by itself), Foam or Tolaria. Notes are plain Markdown files with [[links]]: they open as they are.
mobile.sync.unlink-desc: Stop syncing this vault and forget the password or token kept on this device. Your notes and the repository are not touched.
mobile.sync.conflicts:
Notes changed on two devices at once: {n}. The text of this device was saved beside each one:
{list}
mobile.sync.too-big:
Files too large to sync (over 50 MB), kept on this device only: {n}
{list}
mobile.sync.unwritable:
Files of the repository with names Android cannot store, not copied: {n}
{list}
mobile.sync.offer-text: Sync this vault with GitHub or GitLab: a name and a token are enough, then it works by itself. On the PC, Obsidian, Foam or Tolaria open the same notes.
error.sync-auth: The site refused the name and the password or token. Check them (for GitHub, the token must allow access to repositories).
error.sync-no-repo: Repository not found, or this account may not use it.
error.sync-not-git: That address is not a Git repository.
error.sync-http: The server answered with an error.
error.sync-rejected: The server refused the changes (is the branch protected?).
error.sync-bad-url: That repository address is not valid.
error.sync-not-https: Use an https:// address: the password must not travel in the clear.
error.sync-busy: A sync is running: try again in a moment.
error.sync-not-linked: Sync is not set up for this vault.
error.too-large: The download is too large for this device.
mobile.sync.encrypted: Sync is not available for an encrypted vault: its notes would be readable on the site.
mobile.crypt.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
mobile.crypt.option-desc: The whole vault is kept as one encrypted file and asks for a password to open.
mobile.crypt.warning: Write down the recovery code shown next: with it a forgotten password can be replaced. Without both, nobody can open the vault, you included. At least 8 characters.
mobile.crypt.title: Encryption
mobile.crypt.about: This vault is encrypted. It is kept in the file {file}: only what changes is added to it, a little after each change and whenever you leave the app.
mobile.crypt.change-desc: The current password is asked first.
mobile.crypt.lock-desc: Save, close the vault and ask for the password again.
error.password-short: The password must have at least 8 characters.
error.crypt-damaged: This encrypted vault is damaged or incomplete and cannot be opened.
error.crypt-unavailable: Encryption is not available on this device.
error.vault-locked: This vault is encrypted: its password is needed.
error.sync-encrypted: Sync is not available for an encrypted vault.
mobile.crypt.code-text: If you forget the password, this code is the only way to set a new one. Write it down and keep it somewhere safe, away from this phone. It is shown only now.
mobile.crypt.recover-text: Type the recovery code you were given when the vault was encrypted, then a new password.
mobile.crypt.auto-desc: When you leave sk_notes, the vault locks after this time and asks for the password again. Leaving to pick a photo or to share does not count.
mobile.crypt.lock-now-away: As soon as I leave the app
mobile.crypt.lock-never: Never (only when Android closes the app)
mobile.crypt.new-code-desc: Makes a new code; the old one stops working. The password is asked first.
mobile.crypt.no-code-desc: This vault has no recovery code yet (it was made by an older version): make one now.
mobile.crypt.decrypt-desc: Turns this vault back into a normal folder of notes, readable by any app. The password is asked first.
mobile.crypt.remove-encrypted-confirm: The encrypted file {file} will be deleted. Only the normal folder will be left. Continue?
mobile.crypt.encrypt-desc: Keeps this vault as one encrypted file that asks for a password to open. The notes are checked one by one before anything is deleted.
mobile.crypt.remove-original-desc: Without this the notes also stay readable in the folder, and encryption protects nothing. If the folder is synced with other devices (Syncthing, Git), it is deleted there too.
mobile.crypt.remove-original-confirm: After the encrypted file is made and checked, the folder {folder} will be deleted, with its notes in readable form. Continue?
mobile.crypt.torn: The last save of this vault had been cut short: the previous version was opened, and the file was repaired.
mobile.crypt.conflicts:
Notes changed here were not saved before the vault file was replaced by another copy. They were kept beside the notes ({n}):
{list}
error.no-recovery: This vault has no recovery code.
error.crypt-verify-failed: The encrypted copy did not match the notes: nothing was deleted and nothing was changed.
error.into-itself-vault: A vault cannot be put inside itself.
